semantic_baseline_decision.reason: The repository has no SemanticGuardAccount and no neutral shared semantic-method specification across transfer, approval, swap, batch, freshness, and containment workloads. Adding one after inspecting the existing comparison would require new method and applicability choices that materially change the study design. It is excluded rather than filled with inferred or selectively weak behavior.
semantic_baseline_decision.effect: No execution rows, NOT_APPLICABLE substitutions, or performance/security claims are assigned to a semantic baseline. A separately preregistered future study may add it.

baselines.name: SignatureOnlyAccount
baselines.signed_authorization: agent, nonce, validUntil; chain/account in personal-sign digest
baselines.limitations: No target, calldata, value or outcome commitment; target failure reverts nonce.

baselines.name: SpendLimitGuardAccount
baselines.signed_authorization: agent, token, maximum, nonce, validUntil; chain/account in personal-sign digest
baselines.limitations: Recipient not signed; raw transfer true checked; no post-state. Token false return shares SpendExceeded classification.

baselines.name: PathAndSpendGuardAccount
baselines.signed_authorization: agent, target, selector, maximum, nonce, validUntil; chain/account in personal-sign digest
baselines.limitations: First address argument not signed. No value parameter or batch; selector is signed, not hardcoded to transfer.

baselines.name: CresnexIntentLockAccountV2
baselines.signed_authorization: Complete EIP-712 manifest; ordered calls and policy
baselines.workload_applicability: V2 fixed policy modules and ordered calls
baselines.limitations: Listed outcome constraints only; successful outer receipt may contain rejected inner execution.

baselines.name: SemanticGuardAccount
baselines.limitations: No implemented semantic baseline. A fair shared method specification and workload scope are unresolved; no substitute results.
